alt.back-squat: standing tall at the top: hips and knees fully extended, the barbell still on the upper back, hands on the bar
alt.front-squat: standing tall at the top: knees and hips extended, the barbell still in the front-rack position with elbows high
alt.goblet-squat: standing tall at the top, the dumbbell still held vertically against the chest
alt.smith-squat: standing tall at the top, the bar still on the upper back inside the guide rails
alt.leg-press: legs pushed out almost straight (knees slightly bent, not locked), back still flat on the pad
alt.hack-squat: standing up at the top of the machine, knees almost straight, back still on the pad
alt.bw-squat: standing tall at the top, arms still extended forward at shoulder height
alt.deadlift: standing tall at the lockout: hips and knees fully extended, the barbell hanging in straight arms against the thighs, shoulders back
alt.rdl: standing tall at the top, knees soft, the barbell hanging in straight arms against the thighs
alt.db-rdl: standing tall at the top, the dumbbells hanging in straight arms in front of the thighs
alt.kb-swing: the bottom of the swing: hips hinged back, knees slightly bent, flat back, the kettlebell swung back between the thighs
alt.back-extension: the bottom position: torso bent forward over the hip pad, head toward the floor, back flat, arms still crossed on the chest
alt.split-squat: the top of the split squat: both knees almost straight, long staggered stance, dumbbells at the sides
alt.bulgarian: the top position: front leg almost straight, rear foot still on the bench, dumbbells at the sides
alt.step-up: the start: one foot flat on the box, the other foot on the floor behind, torso slightly forward
alt.bw-split-squat: the top position: both knees almost straight in a long staggered stance, hands on hips
alt.leg-extension: the start: knees bent about 90°, shins vertical under the seat with the pad on the lower shins
alt.leg-curl: the start: legs extended forward almost straight, the ankle pad behind the lower calves
alt.hip-thrust: the bottom position: hips lowered toward the floor, upper back still on the bench, barbell on the hips
alt.glute-bridge: the bottom position: lying flat on the back, hips resting ON THE FLOOR, knees bent, feet flat; no barbell or plate
alt.calf-raise: the bottom position: heels lowered below the step edge, calves stretched
alt.bench-press: the top position: arms straight, the barbell locked out directly above the shoulders
alt.db-bench: the top position: arms straight, the dumbbells pressed up above the chest
alt.machine-chest-press: the pressed position: both arms pushed FORWARD almost straight (elbows only slightly bent), the handles now about 50 cm in front of the chest, back still on the pad
alt.push-up: the top position: arms straight, body in one straight line from head to heels
alt.dips: the BOTTOM of the dip: the body lowered about 25 cm compared to image 1 — elbows bent to 90° and pointing back, upper arms parallel to the floor, shoulders now at the level of the hands, torso leaning forward 30°, still gripping the same bars
alt.incline-db-press: the top position: arms straight, dumbbells pressed up above the upper chest
alt.incline-bench: the top position: arms straight, the barbell locked out above the upper chest
alt.cable-fly: the start: arms open wide to the sides at shoulder height in an arc, elbows slightly bent, chest stretched, still holding both handles
alt.pec-deck: the squeeze position: the padded arms brought together in front of the chest
alt.db-fly: the top position: the dumbbells brought together above the chest in a hugging arc, elbows slightly bent
alt.ohp: the start: the barbell resting on the front shoulders at collarbone height, forearms vertical, elbows slightly in front of the bar
alt.db-shoulder-press: the top position: arms extended overhead, the dumbbells above the shoulders
alt.machine-shoulder-press: the top position: arms extended overhead, still holding the handles, back on the pad
alt.pike-push-up: the TOP position: arms fully straight (elbows locked), the head lifted well off the floor between the upper arms, hips high in an inverted V
alt.lateral-raise: the start: arms down at the sides, dumbbells beside the thighs
alt.cable-lateral-raise: the start: working arm down in front of the hips holding the handle, cable taut
alt.face-pull: the start: arms extended forward toward the pulley at face height, holding the rope
alt.reverse-fly: the start: both arms reaching straight FORWARD in front of the chest at shoulder height (seen from behind, the arms point away from the camera and are mostly hidden by the shoulders), hands shoulder-width apart, the band slack
alt.barbell-row: the bottom position: arms hanging straight below the shoulders holding the barbell, torso still hinged with a flat back
alt.db-row: the bottom position: the working arm hanging straight down holding the dumbbell, torso still parallel to the floor
alt.cable-row: the start: arms extended forward holding the handle, torso upright, shoulder blades stretched forward
alt.chest-supported-row: the bottom position: arms hanging straight down holding the dumbbells, chest still on the pad
alt.inverted-row: the bottom position: arms straight, hanging under the bar, body still in one straight line
alt.pull-up: the bottom position: dead hang with arms straight, shoulders active, body straight
alt.chin-up: the bottom position: dead hang with straight arms, underhand grip, body straight
alt.lat-pulldown: the start: arms fully extended overhead holding the wide bar, still seated with thighs under the pads
alt.db-shrug: the bottom position: shoulders relaxed down, arms straight holding the dumbbells
alt.barbell-curl: the bottom position: arms straight, the barbell hanging against the thighs, elbows at the sides
alt.db-curl: the bottom position: arms straight down at the sides holding the dumbbells, palms forward
alt.hammer-curl: the bottom position: arms straight down at the sides, neutral grip
alt.incline-curl: the bottom position: arms hanging straight down behind the torso line holding the dumbbells
alt.cable-curl: the bottom position: arms straight, the bar in front of the thighs
alt.pushdown: the start: forearms raised, elbows bent about 90° at the sides, the bar at chest height
alt.overhead-extension: the top position: arms extended straight overhead holding the dumbbell
alt.skull-crusher: the top position: arms extended straight up above the shoulders holding the bar
alt.close-grip-bench: the top position: arms straight, the barbell locked out above the chest
alt.bench-dip: the top position: arms straight, hips up beside the bench edge, legs still extended
alt.hanging-leg-raise: the bottom position: hanging with straight arms and legs straight down
alt.cable-crunch: the start: kneeling upright with a long straight spine, rope held beside the head
alt.crunch: the bottom position: lying flat on the back, knees bent, hands crossed on the chest
alt.dead-bug: the start: lying on the back, BOTH arms pointing straight up to the ceiling, BOTH legs lifted with knees bent 90° directly above the hips (no leg is extended)
